The source includes Taiwan’s outer boundary but does not provide its internal divisions. Municipalities, Hong Kong, and Macao have district subdivisions instead of a prefecture layer.

The map follows the provider’s boundary and territory representation. These are generalized visualization boundaries; the download date does not establish that all recent administrative changes are included. No street or satellite basemap is mixed with this coordinate data.
